learnings: Threads help with I/O-bound work: while one waits on the network, others run.
Read-modify-write on shared state is a race; a `Lock` makes the section atomic.
`queue.Queue` is the safe hand-over point between producers and consumers; sentinels stop workers cleanly.
pitfalls: With the GIL, pure-Python CPU work does not get faster with threads – the experiment shows a speed-up near 1×.
next: Use separate processes for CPU-bound work on Day 74.
